name: time-from-unixtime
query: * | select from_unixtime(__time__) as t order by __time__ limit 1

name: time-date-format
query: * | select date_format(from_unixtime(__time__), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as t order by t limit 1

name: time-date-format-bigint
query: * | select date_format(__time__, '%H:%i') as t, count(*) as c group by t order by t limit 2

name: time-date-trunc
query: * | select date_trunc('minute', from_unixtime(__time__)) as t, count(*) as c group by t order by t limit 2

name: time-date-trunc-bigint
query: * | select date_trunc('minute', __time__) as t, count(*) as c group by t order by t limit 2

name: time-series
query: * | select time_series(__time__, '1m', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s', '0') as t, count(*) as c group by t order by t limit 3

name: time-date-diff
query: * | select date_diff('second', from_unixtime(min(__time__)), from_unixtime(max(__time__))) as d

name: time-date-add
query: * | select date_add('minute', 1, from_unixtime(1794662100)) as t

name: time-to-unixtime
query: * | select to_unixtime(from_unixtime(1794662100)) as t

name: time-extract
query: * | select extract(hour from from_unixtime(1794662100)) as h, hour(from_unixtime(1794662100)) as h2, minute(from_unixtime(1794662100)) as m

name: time-day-of-week
query: * | select day_of_week(from_unixtime(1794662100)) as w, day_of_year(from_unixtime(1794662100)) as y

name: time-literals
query: * | select date '2026-11-14' as d, timestamp '2026-11-14 10:00:00' as t

name: time-at-time-zone
query: * | select from_unixtime(1794662100) at time zone 'UTC' as t

name: time-interval
query: * | select from_unixtime(1794662100) + interval '1' hour as t

name: str-basic
query: * | select lower('AbC') as l, upper('AbC') as u, length('héllo') as n, substr('abcdef', 2, 3) as s, concat('a', '-', 'b') as c

name: str-split
query: * | select split('a:b:c', ':') as a, split_part('a:b:c', ':', 2) as b, strpos('hello', 'l') as c, replace('aaa', 'a', 'b') as d, trim('  a ') as e

name: str-regexp
query: * | select regexp_extract('ab12cd', '\d+') as a, regexp_like('topup', '^top') as b, regexp_replace('hello', 'l', 'L') as c, regexp_extract_all('a1b2', '\d') as d

name: str-pad
query: * | select lpad('7', 3, '0') as l, rpad('7', 3, '0') as r, reverse('abc') as v, position('c' in 'abc') as p

name: json-funcs
query: * | select json_extract_scalar('{"a":{"b":1}}', '$.a.b') as a, json_extract('{"a":[1,2]}', '$.a') as b, json_array_length('[1,2,3]') as n

name: json-parse
query: * | select json_parse('[1,2]') as c, json_format(json_parse('{"x":1}')) as d

name: json-field
query: * | select json_extract_scalar(ctx, '$.user.tier') as tier, count(*) as c where ctx is not null group by tier order by tier

name: url-funcs
query: * | select url_extract_host('https://a.b.com/x?y=1') as h, url_extract_path('https://a.b.com/x?y=1') as p, url_extract_parameter('https://a.b.com/x?y=1', 'y') as q

name: url-encode
query: * | select url_encode('a b') as e, url_decode('a%20b') as d

name: hash-funcs
query: * | select to_hex(md5(to_utf8('a'))) as h, to_base64(to_utf8('a')) as b, from_utf8(from_base64('YQ==')) as f

name: math
query: * | select round(3.14159, 2) as r, floor(1.7) as f, ceil(1.2) as c, abs(-3) as a, power(2, 10) as p, sqrt(16) as s, mod(7, 3) as m, ln(1) as l

name: literals
query: * | select 1 as a, 1.0 as b, 0.1 + 0.2 as c, null as d, true as e, 'x' as f

name: literals-num
query: * | select 1e3 as a, 1.5e-2 as b, 100000000000000000000.0 as c, 3.14159265358979 as d, cast(1 as double) as e, cast(10000000 as double) as f

name: casts
query: * | select cast(1 as varchar) as g, cast('2' as bigint) as h, cast(1.5 as bigint) as i, cast('1.5' as double) as j, typeof(1) as k

name: bool
query: * | select true and false as a, not true as b, 1 < 2 as c

name: array-literal
query: * | select array[1,2] as a, contains(array[1,2], 2) as b, element_at(array[1,2], 2) as c, array_join(array['a','b'], ',') as d, cardinality(array[1,2,3]) as e

name: array-agg
query: * | select array_agg(distinct level) as a

name: map-agg
query: * | select map_agg(level, c) as m from (select level, count(*) as c from log group by level)

name: histogram-fn
query: * | select histogram(level) as h

name: numeric-histogram
query: * | select numeric_histogram(4, latency_ms) as h

name: approx-percentile
query: * | select approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.5) as p50, approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) as p95, approx_percentile(latency_ms, array[0.5, 0.99]) as ps

name: approx-distinct
query: * | select approx_distinct(trace_id) as d, count(distinct trace_id) as e

name: agg-misc
query: * | select max_by(msg, latency_ms) as m, min_by(msg, latency_ms) as n, count_if(latency_ms > 300) as ci, bool_and(latency_ms > 0) as ba, bool_or(latency_ms > 1000) as bo, arbitrary(service) is not null as ar

name: agg-stats
query: * | select stddev(latency_ms) as s, variance(latency_ms) as v, stddev_pop(latency_ms) as sp, corr(latency_ms, latency_ms) as r, geometric_mean(latency_ms) as g

name: compare
query: * | select compare(c, 60) as r from (select count(*) as c from log)

name: ip-funcs
query: * | select ip_to_country('8.8.8.8') as a, ip_to_province('114.114.114.114') as b, ip_to_city('114.114.114.114') as c, ip_to_provider('114.114.114.114') as d

name: unknown-func
query: * | select foo(1) as x

name: nested-agg
query: * | select compare(count(*), 60) as c
